latexExportHint: PDF export compiles the current source first. A failed build stops the export.
latexToolchainHint: Install a TeX distribution with latexmk and your selected engine. Source editing and saving remain available.
latexPreviewHint: Compile to see your typeset paper. The last successful PDF stays visible while you keep writing.

latexDiagnostic_missing-package: A file or package is missing. Check the project files or install the required TeX package.
latexDiagnostic_undefined-command: This command may need a package, or its spelling may be incorrect.
latexDiagnostic_citation: Check the bibliography key and the corresponding BibTeX entry.
latexDiagnostic_overflow: A line or box exceeds its intended width.
latexReviewHint: Review the proposed source changes. They are saved only after you accept them.
latexSearchPapers: Search title, author, year or citation key
latexNoReferences: No matches. Add papers to your library or edit a .bib file.
latexFixInstruction: Fix the LaTeX build errors with the smallest necessary source changes.
latexChooseMain: Several main documents were found. Choose one before compiling.
latexRevisePlaceholder: How should Kun revise this selection?
latexDiscussSelection: Discuss this LaTeX selection without changing files.
latexOldPdf: Showing the PDF from {{time}} · source has newer changes
latexCreateHint: Create a paper project in this Work space. Your source files remain ordinary files.
latexTemplateHint_blank: article · main.tex · choose an engine later
latexCreateNoTools: Creating a project does not require TeX. Tools are checked on the first compile.

latexTexPathHint: Leave blank to search PATH and standard installation directories.
